fields.name: isFeaturedBlog
fields.label: Is Featured Blog
fields.description: Turn on to make the blog featured and to show this blog in the Featured Blogs carousel.

fields.name: hide-header
fields.label: Hide Header
fields.description: Turn on to hide the header on this page.

fields.name: theme
fields.label: Theme
fields.description: Page-level look. Combat applies the JSW Combat model page styling to this page's blocks only.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: Optional. The footer page this page shows, e.g. /gurgaon/meridian-motors/footer for a dealer. Empty: the site's /footer.

fields.name: footer-style
fields.label: Footer Style
fields.description: Default: the site footer. Dealer: the dealer footer (link columns, Connect icons, legal band). Unset, a footer with columns but no logo shows as Dealer.

fields.name: dealercode
fields.label: Dealer Code
fields.description: Dealer pages only. The dealer's code, sent with every quote request from this page's Get in touch form (as dealerCodeSalesUnit), e.g. DLR00187.
